column3: Do you have a list of approved/preferred suppliers with basic evaluation criteria?
column5: Inconsistent ingredient/product quality; food safety incidents; supply disruptions

column3: Do you check supplier hygiene, freshness, and quality standards before accepting deliveries?
column5: Customer illness, complaints, or food safety violation; potential business closure

column3: Do you have a minimum contract or written agreement with your key suppliers?
column5: No legal protection if supplier fails; no recourse for quality failures

column3: Do you evaluate suppliers periodically (e.g. annually) based on quality and reliability?
column5: Locked into underperforming suppliers; no systematic improvement of supply chain

column3: Are key operational processes (e.g. food prep, check-in, room cleaning) documented in any form — even simple written guides?
column5: Inconsistent service quality; high retraining cost; errors when staff change

column3: Do staff have clear role descriptions and know who is responsible for what?
column5: Confusion, duplication, and gaps in service delivery; poor accountability

column3: Do you have a way to identify when errors, delays, or rework are happening frequently?
column5: Preventable costs build up silently; staff frustration and turnover risk

column3: Do managers conduct regular team check-ins or briefings (daily/weekly)?
column5: Low team awareness; issues surface late; service inconsistency across shifts

column3: Do all staff have written employment contracts that comply with Vietnamese labour law?
column5: Labour dispute risk; fines from labour authority inspections; reputational exposure

column3: Are working hours, overtime, and leave entitlements tracked and documented?
column5: Disputes over pay and leave; legal penalties; staff grievances and turnover

column3: Do you have a basic health & safety protocol covering kitchen hazards, slip risks, or fire safety?
column5: Workplace accidents; liability; potential injury to staff and customers

column3: Is there a clear and accessible process for staff to raise concerns or complaints internally?
column5: Unresolved grievances escalate; external complaints; media/social media exposure

column3: Do you conduct at least a basic induction/onboarding for new staff on safety and conduct?
column5: New staff unaware of risks; early-stage accidents or misconduct more likely

column3: Do hiring decisions focus on skill and fit rather than personal characteristics unrelated to the role?
column5: Legal discrimination risk; limited talent pool; reputational damage

column3: Do all staff — regardless of age, gender, or background — have equal access to training and advancement?
column5: High turnover among underrepresented groups; missed talent development
